mapper.select:
SELECT G.GROUP_ID, G.GROUP_NAME, G.TRIP_TYPE, G.LOCATION, G.START_DATE, G.END_DATE, G.MAX_MEMBERS, G.ESTIMATED_BUDGET, G.DESCRIPTION, G.IMAGE_URL, G.STATUS, G.CREATED_BY, G.CREATED_AT, G.UPDATED_AT, M.NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, COUNT(TM.MEMBER_ID) AS CURRENT_MEMBERS FROM TRIP_GROUP G LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON G.CREATED_BY = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TRIP_MEMBER TM ON G.GROUP_ID = TM.GROUP_ID
AND G.TRIP_TYPE = #{tripType}
AND (G.GROUP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR G.LOCATION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY G.GROUP_ID ORDER BY G.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT G.GROUP_ID, G.GROUP_NAME, G.TRIP_TYPE, G.LOCATION, G.START_DATE, G.END_DATE, G.MAX_MEMBERS, G.ESTIMATED_BUDGET, G.DESCRIPTION, G.IMAGE_URL, G.STATUS, G.CREATED_BY, G.CREATED_AT, G.UPDATED_AT, M.NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, COUNT(TM.MEMBER_ID) AS CURRENT_MEMBERS FROM TRIP_GROUP G LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON G.CREATED_BY = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TRIP_MEMBER TM ON G.GROUP_ID = TM.GROUP_ID WHERE G.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} GROUP BY G.GROUP_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRIP_GROUP ( GROUP_NAME, TRIP_TYPE, LOCATION, START_DATE, END_DATE, MAX_MEMBERS, ESTIMATED_BUDGET, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{groupName}, #{tripType}, #{location}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{maxMembers}, #{estimatedBudget}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO TRIP_MEMBER (GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, ROLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TRIP_MEMBER WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
